factions.name: The Emberwatch
factions.blurb: The secret order the party is Emberbound to.

factions.name: The Miners' Guild
factions.blurb: Longsaddle's guild, headed by Tarn Suldaver.

factions.name: The Pale Lodge
factions.blurb: Hunters of false gods. Blue tabard, gold circle.

factions.name: House Vaelcrest
factions.blurb: Lord Edrion's house, holding Neverwinter against the Crown.

factions.name: House Crimson
factions.blurb: Creed's house and the party's original patrons.

quests.title: A Lecture at the Collegium
quests.stakes: The Headmaster asked Carver to give his students a guest lecture.
quests.lead: Agreed, for after the blockade breaks. The Headmaster will find Carver at the Rail.

quests.title: Audience at Castle Never
quests.giver: Lord Edrion Vaelcrest, by Advocate Ineth Ravelle
quests.stakes: Lord Edrion wants to meet the party about the raw face at Griffon's Nest. Ravelle's written promises are pending: property, a liquor licence, unlimited Magistone with sharing, Carver's rights, intel for Varsen. Handout: The Summons to Neverwinter.
quests.lead: Met Lord Edrion at Castle Never, 25 Kythorn. The party will work with Neverwinter as allies, not under its command. The twins' property has been delivered; the other promises have not yet been discussed.

quests.title: Cass Stormrider's Research
quests.stakes: Cass is testing coloured Magistone, including green, on living things.
quests.lead: Open question: does use on living things change the stone?

quests.title: Creed's Ask
quests.stakes: Creed asked the party to end the compulsion.
quests.lead: Creed left with Kael.

quests.title: Dren Kolvar
quests.stakes: Bounty hunter holding a warrant on the whole party: 250 gp each, 1,000 gp for either twin.
quests.lead: Bounties have tripled. He may still be tracking the party.

quests.title: Echoes of Brightfire
quests.stakes: Find out what happened to Creed's mother, Corinne, in the sealed Brightfire Institute.
quests.lead: Vault opened; Corinne's fate learned. Vaross is alive. Carver received a Pale Lodge coin.

quests.title: Emberance
quests.lead: Completed.

quests.title: Gull Rock
quests.stakes: Daunt inherited Gull Rock from his great-aunt, Lady Odile Daunt. The harbor court condemned it last year, and the city still taxes it quarterly. Per Daunt: creatures attack anyone trying to remove them, there are mists, and dockworkers hear screams. Locals call it the Grey Maiden of Gull Rock. Reward: the island for 1 gp once it is certified safe.
quests.lead: Jasper accepted, 26 Kythorn. The party holds a ring of 5 keys to the island's buildings. Daunt is staying at the Beached Leviathan. 27 Kythorn: Jasper put it to the party; agreed for after the blockade.

quests.title: Hans's Amplifier
quests.stakes: Carver builds an amplifier for Hans.
quests.lead: Finished.

quests.title: Hold for Onward: Facility 6
quests.stakes: Darion & Vasse ships Longsaddle's stone to an unnamed destination. Harwick named Facility 6 and said Althin Vaross is likely running research there.
quests.lead: Manifests at Lisbeth Crane's factor office read 'hold for onward — F6'. The party believes Harwick meant the mountains of Moray.

quests.title: Lisbeth's Two Days
quests.stakes: Lisbeth Crane is staying two days at her sister's.
quests.lead: 27 Kythorn: collected from the East Gate holding cell. Working at The Flaunty Flagon.

quests.title: Onotaro's Hat
quests.stakes: Win a hat from the Vestarian Daughters.
quests.lead: Won.

quests.title: Operation Castle Shadow
quests.stakes: Take the Dawngate District and get beneath the palace.
quests.lead: General Althorn defeated at Dawngate. Party entered under the palace through the north storm culvert.

quests.title: Operation Enduring Flesh
quests.stakes: Find out what the Crown ran beneath the Lower City grain mill.
quests.lead: Facility 9 cleared and sealed. Ashvain Concordance recovered. Seraph woke.

quests.title: Operation Gatefall
quests.stakes: Open Suzail's western gate before dawn.
quests.lead: Captured Crimson soldiers freed and armed. Radiant Frame destroyed. Commander Holst defeated. Western gate opened.

quests.title: Operation High Tower
quests.stakes: Clear the Moon Tower and take the throne room.
quests.lead: Tower cleared, prisoner freed, throne room taken. The Cormyrian Civil War ended.

quests.title: Owlbear Feathers
quests.giver: Archmaester Sulfuras Honnold, Circle of the Arcane Eye
quests.stakes: Posted request for feathers from a specific group of owlbears in the Neverwinter Wood.
quests.lead: Ask for Honnold at the Circle of the Arcane Eye.

quests.title: Pit or Purse
quests.giver: Bracken Tull, for Lady Vessa Marrowmont
quests.stakes: Contract signed 26 Kythorn: win three fights at the Gullet and the 700-crown Gleamhammer debt is cleared, plus 10% of the take above the first 700 gp. Yield (weapon down, both hands up) or die and the debt becomes three open-ended tasks for Marrowmont. Per Edrion: the paper is legitimate. Per Tull: a good show earns what they know about Varsen's sisters.
quests.lead: 26 Kythorn: won fight 3 (a froghemoth). Brass Oakum burned the debt paper in the arena. Party's share of the take: 154 gp.

quests.title: Salt Fire
quests.giver: A Pale Lodge Herald at the Horologe
quests.stakes: Per the Lodge, false-god blight has settled on Neverwinter. Salt Fire reveals and tracks it. Use it in unusual places and report back.
quests.lead: 27 Kythorn: Huntmaster Virel met the party at the Rail; mote and Brightfire relic shown. Per Virel: the relic is an anchor, a map and a key; about 15 remain; 4–5 motes would reactivate it. Use Salt Fire in unusual places and report back. Handout: Of the Seven and the Eighth (pending).

quests.title: Seraph
quests.stakes: Seraph woke in Facility 9. Handout: Project: Seraph – Player Facing.
quests.lead: Per Harwick: charged from a relic holding a piece of Bast, killed most of the room at its trials, may still be beneath Suzail. Per Virel: an "abomination"; that it spared the party is rare, but some false gods have been reported to act without malice.

quests.title: Taking Griffon's Nest
quests.stakes: Take Griffon's Nest from Darion & Vasse.
quests.lead: Nest taken by midnight.

quests.title: The Banquet
quests.stakes: Escape Suzail after the Banquet Betrayal.
quests.lead: Escaped.

quests.title: The Bloodtithe
quests.stakes: A weapon commissioned for Varsen.
quests.lead: Bloodtithe forged for Varsen.

quests.title: The Cobalt Covenant
quests.stakes: A rumored kobold conspiracy in Suzail's undercity.
quests.lead: Meeting set for the eastern wharf on the 29th. Nobody went; the date has passed.

quests.title: The Covenant of Dusk
quests.stakes: Five cultists in the cave below Secumber stabbed themselves to feed a statue, releasing the Unlit. The party destroyed it and kept the green mote it left. Handout: The Quiet Codex — The First Verse (Of Noise).
quests.lead: The lead cultist's pamphlet ends: 'The world will not end. It will exhale.' A sixth man had the Covenant's mark behind his left ear and the first chapter of a credo. The green mote was shown to a Pale Lodge Herald, 25 Kythorn (see Salt Fire). Per Virel, 27 Kythorn: the mote is true Titan essence. In the Aetherfold the Covenant operates as the Silicant Council. Varric Morvain has lived thousands of years, worships the Pale Regent, and is the greatest threat on this plane. Mass gatherings of faith can raise a Titan echo or open a rift to the Aetherfold. Crimson Magistone does not occur naturally; it is corrupted green "life stone".

quests.title: The Doctor Will See You Now
quests.stakes: Dr. Pell Harwick, a Facility 9 surgeon, was free in Baldur's Gate.
quests.lead: Found, interrogated and killed.

quests.title: The Flaunty Flagon
quests.giver: Osric Tolliver, Office of Deeds and Conveyance
quests.stakes: The twins own the former Marrowgate Salon on Blacklake and plan to open a tavern and inn. Per Osric Tolliver: seven owners in nine years, 'a room that never feels empty', furnishings stay put.
quests.lead: 27 Kythorn: first visit. Run-down; harp lounge, wet bar, hearth lounge, loft, patio with boat dock on Blacklake. Lisbeth is getting it into shape. Loan from the Bank of Neverwinter: 1,000 gp at 2% a year over 10 years, monthly payments from 1 Eleasis, made by Lisbeth.

quests.title: The Frame under the Crag
quests.stakes: Carver has claimed the Radiant Frame in Griffon's Nest.
quests.lead: Left under the Crag with instructions for moving it to the surface.

quests.title: The Good Neighbor
quests.stakes: Varsen and Onotaro each carry a Good Neighbor coin, given with talk of gatherings and teachings in the Moonshaes.
quests.lead: Per Virel: the coin's sun lines up with House Morvain's seal (a rising sun ringed by a thousand hands) on a City of Shade document. He warns that large gatherings of faith can be misused.

quests.title: The Green Harvest
quests.stakes: Investigate the problem with Secumber's harvest.
quests.lead: Secumber's stone returned to Hessa.

quests.title: The Grenholm Contract
quests.stakes: Find the Pale Lodge's missing Pursuant near Norfinn Lake. Payment: one question, one true answer.
quests.lead: Per Virel, 27 Kythorn: the Lodge adherent is missing on Norland; villagers report effigies washing ashore and a god they don't know. Per Virel, the effigies are for the Pale Regent. On completion, Carver is introduced to a soul-splitting teacher.

quests.title: The Griffon Tithe
quests.stakes: Find who poisoned the griffons' tithe.
quests.lead: Traced to the meat store with Cass's bloodhound.

quests.title: The Harpells' Ledgers
quests.stakes: Someone in Longsaddle is reporting on the town to the Crown.

quests.title: The Heralds' Maker
quests.stakes: Carver asked for the Lodge's promised Herald-making. Per Virel: Huntmaster Krayt of the East made the Heralds and would teach loyal Lodge members.
quests.lead: Krayt is on the border of the Eastern Kingdoms and the Beastlands. Per Virel, the party will meet him soon.

quests.title: The Hush
quests.stakes: Nine people vanished from the Lower City.
quests.lead: Banderhobbs killed. The Flaming Fist paid.

quests.title: The Lamprey
quests.stakes: A six-crew submersible. Board the Crown blockade's flagship during the bombing and take its orders, valuables and items before it sinks.
quests.lead: All six will take part. Report to Chief Engineer Odalric Fenwhistle at first light, 28 Kythorn.

quests.title: The Longsaddle Charter
quests.stakes: House Vaelcrest wanted Griffon's Nest; Longsaddle wanted wages, protection and a say in its future.
quests.lead: Charter signed at Feldryn's.

quests.title: The Neverwinter Hearth
quests.stakes: The Emberwatch has a hearth in Neverwinter. Handout: Emberwatch Field Ledger.

quests.title: The Ninth Life
quests.stakes: A sealed house of Bast.
quests.lead: The Ninth Life recovered from the Reliquary of Bast.

quests.title: The Proving
quests.stakes: Monthly Problem from the Vaelcrest Collegium; shops compete. Flamerule's Problem (Carver saw it early, asked to destroy the copy): a device to quickly put out Crown fire ships, usable by someone who is not resonant.
quests.lead: Opens 1 Flamerule. Carver plans to enter with elemental Magistone; Headmaster Gambling showed him the Problem early. Carver and Edrion agreed to share findings once the Proving is over.

quests.title: The Quiet One at Talfir
quests.stakes: Pale Lodge contract on the Quiet One at Talfir.
quests.lead: Contract filled; Lodge coins notched.

quests.title: The Redeemer's Core
quests.giver: Lord Edrion Vaelcrest, through Kael's deckhands
quests.stakes: Edrion's airship, built in a hidden hangar east of Neverwinter, is meant to break the Crown blockade.
quests.lead: Shown to Carver, Jasper, Varsen and Onotaro on the night of 25 Kythorn. Complete: 8 Riftborn cores (4 sockets empty), lift from a stored reverse-gravity spell, fire-resonance engine, grapeshot cannons, about 24 Magistone charges set to burst at the waterline. Bombing run on the evening of 28 Kythorn.

quests.title: The Sealed North Shaft
quests.stakes: Nine men dug the sealed north section of the mine; none came out unchanged.
quests.lead: Completed.

quests.title: The Stairwives
quests.stakes: Find what was taking people from the poor quarters.
quests.lead: The party killed the banderhobb, uncovered the coven and informed the Flaming Fist.

quests.title: The Steelwatch Waybill
quests.stakes: Deliver a wrecked caravan's waybill to the Miners' Guild Hall in Longsaddle.
quests.lead: Delivered to Guildmaster Tarn Suldaver.

quests.title: The Vanished House
quests.stakes: House Ashvain vanished from its Starmantle estate in 1484 DR with no bodies, struggle or arcane trace. Handout: Ashvain Concordance.
quests.lead: Per Harwick: Adrion and Selise were being sent to Facility 6 when he last heard; plans may have changed.

quests.title: Varsen's Sisters
quests.stakes: Brenna and Brunna borrowed 700 gp from Marrowmont's Table to buy two prospecting claims from Neverwinter Survey. They agreed to weekly payments and made none.
quests.lead: Per Bracken Tull's file: claims near the Bukhara Spires in central Gwyneth (Moonshaes), and near Kagar, a large village in the southeast of House Amcathra's lands on the Eastern Kingdoms border, by the Golden Plains. The sisters left Neverwinter about a month ago. Per Edrion: his people are looking. Per Tabaxi merchants in the Bazaar: the sisters' mother went missing searching for her husband.

quests.title: What Onotaro Lost
quests.stakes: Onotaro has no memory of his life before Strike Team Four.
quests.lead: 27 Kythorn: the hadozee is Huntmaster Virel of the West, one of four Huntmasters. Per Virel: they both come from the Aetherfold; Onotaro's role is "much greater than a mere spelljammer"; who he was is not Virel's to tell. Huntmaster Krayt of the East will tell him, and the party will meet Krayt soon.

quests.title: Winning the Miners' Guild
quests.stakes: Win the support of Longsaddle's Miners' Guild.
quests.lead: The Guild backs the party.

changes: Pit or Purse resolved: the Gleamhammer debt is cleared; party share 154 gp
Varsen's Sisters: claims near the Bukhara Spires (Gwyneth) and Kagar (Amcathra lands); the sisters left a month ago
New: The Heralds' Maker (Carver) — seek Huntmaster Krayt of the East
New on the board: The Good Neighbor — the coin matches House Morvain's seal
Salt Fire / Covenant of Dusk: Huntmaster Virel on Titan essence, relics, and the Pale Regent
What Onotaro Lost: Krayt of the East will tell Onotaro who he was
Lisbeth arrived; The Flaunty Flagon has a Bank of Neverwinter loan (1,000 gp)
The Lamprey: all six report to Fenwhistle at first light, 28 Kythorn
New pursuit: Carver's Nullstone teleportation (1/50 days)
